summary: Technical audit analyzed 112 pages and 4895 links. Identified 3 key findings with score 86/100.

findings.title: Missing Canonical Tags
findings.description: 2 indexable page(s) lack a canonical URL tag.
findings.impact: Vulnerability to duplicate content penalties if URLs are accessible with query parameters or trailing slashes.
findings.recommendation: Add a self-referential `<link rel='canonical' href='...' />` tag in the `<head>` of each page.

findings.title: Noindex Directives Present
findings.impact: These pages will be deliberately omitted from search engine result pages.
findings.recommendation: Verify that no crucial landing pages or revenue-generating content are blocked by noindex tags.

findings.title: No XML Sitemap Discovered
findings.description: Crawler did not discover a standard sitemap at /sitemap.xml or referenced in robots.txt.
findings.impact: Search engines may take longer to discover and index new or updated URLs.
findings.recommendation: Generate an XML sitemap, place it in the root directory, and specify its URL in robots.txt.
